instructions.D_06_flow_validation_error: Round 11 current-dominant. Rebuild one 2048x1152 ClearVision D Flow Validation Error screen from CURRENT S04-B2, the ClearVision-only D Flow architecture blueprint, and the promoted D Flow Master. CURRENT is the sole authority for functions, Chinese copy, fields, values, state, and evidence; the blueprint is structure-only and the Master is style-only. Change geometry only and honor exact horizontal boundaries: compact discovery x=0-68, dotted FlowCanvas x=68-1502, selected Inspector x=1502-1832 (330px; hard range 320-340px), and collapsed Preview/Result edge x=1832-2048. Preserve one Product Shell with 概览 / 工程 / 流程 / 检测结果 / 算子库; 工程详情 / 瓶盖检测 A; 最终判定, 保存, 结果, 检查条件, 正式运行, 运行详情; 正式运行就绪, 状态已读取, 运行检查通过, and the existing saved/local-revision status. Keep only one Binary-to-Image flow: selected Inspector Source to Inspector Target. In the Inspector preserve Inspector Source, enabled state, 0 入 · 1 出, 输出 二值图 / Image, 专用工作台 · 1 项, FilePath, 延后到 Host file picker, 选择文件, Text / 字符串参数, 数量 *=11, 参数校验未通过, 数量不能大于 10, and 无效参数字段. Keep the existing no-image Preview/Result projection, 预览中, 结果摘要, ROI unsupported state, and locally generated structured-result state. Do not add or rename any field, status, node, command, tab, navigation, validation rule, auto-fix, error action, run control, device ability, or data. No Windows controls, permanent multi-icon capability rail, Fit, Auto Layout, fullscreen control, Roboflow label, or third-party function.
instructions.D_07_flow_preview_roi: Round 11 current-dominant. CURRENT is the sole authority for functions, Chinese copy, state, values, and bitmap evidence; the blueprint is structure-only and the Master is style-only. Extend the very-light dotted FlowCanvas to x about 1320 and keep it at 59-61% of the full viewport; allocate 35-37% to the right Preview/ROI image and result context. Preserve one Product Shell, project context, readiness/read/validation statuses, save/final-decision/check-condition/formal-run/run-details actions, one ROI Rectangle node, and the ROI draft warning. Use the actual CURRENT 100x100 black artifact with the same red patch/crack evidence. Preserve Rectangle, X=10, Y=10, Width=30, Height=20; the existing image zoom, fit-preview-area, actual-pixel, large-image and pixel-probe tools; result summary, key output, structured output, additional result and diagnostic projection; ROI undo, redo, 放弃, and 应用 ROI. Do not show 取消预览 because canCancel is false. Add no ROI type, image tool, preview mode, command, tab, node, device ability, save path, Windows control, help, notification, Inspector, invented image, text, value, or data.
